target-type.description: The gRPC tunnel target being configured

enable.description: Enable or disable this gRPC tunnel destination

port-override.description: Use the provided port-override-value for this target type instead of the default port value.

server-id.description: User-provided identifier for this gRPC tunnel destination configuration

destination-port.description: The destination port that will be used for the outbound gRPC connection

insecure.description: The outgoing connection to the destination is insecure
